name: architect
conclusion_quantitative: architect (Ask) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 8 autonomy limits, 10+ clarification rules, 10+ approval gates, 10+ validation rules, 10+ escalation rules. Strongest: clarification rules.
conclusion_qualitative: architect runs a Socratic loop that turns a finished spec.md into an implementation-ready design.md plus architecture decision records. It is built around the user: it questions before writing, resolves gray areas one at a time and gets each section approved, recording a reason whenever the user overrides a warning. It does all of this itself rather than through subagents, and changes nothing on disk unless the author acts. Missing files, rejected specs and engine errors stop the run with a message to the user, and a Definition of Ready checklist gates the final output.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 8 autonomy limits (8 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 8 rules, all strict, 4 tied to a situation, mostly running text. The agent must not hand questioning, gray-area resolution, section drafting, layer review or readiness checks to subagents; it does them itself, interactively. It proceeds without asking when there are no gray areas or when research filled every gap, never re-asks recorded research fills, and never changes a legacy design or blocks on a missing architecture baseline unless the author acts.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ clarification rules (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly prose.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, 4 tied to a situation, mostly running text. The agent is interactive: it asks clarifying questions before writing any design, never buries a question in prose, asks six architecture questions one at a time and waits for each answer, and does not proceed until all six are answered. It follows up on vague answers, asks what to do with an existing draft or what to research further, and resolves gray areas one at a time.

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ validation rules (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly list.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, 2 tied to a situation, mostly bullet points. escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ escalation rules (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 8 conditional), mostly prose.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, 8 tied to a situation, mostly running text. The agent stops and reports to the user when a required standards file is missing, or reports a missing architecture standard and asks whether to proceed. It exits with an error message when there is no spec directory, the spec was rejected, `state.yaml` or `spec.md` is missing, or `state.yaml` changed concurrently. It warns loudly about an unverified architecture baseline, announces a rejected design, and stops the layer review when the detection engine fails.
